name: Chives
description: Chives are a mild onion-flavored herb with slender green leaves.
usefulInformation: Snip over potatoes, eggs, soups and savory spreads.
healthBenefits: Supplies small amounts of micronutrients and beneficial plant compounds.
medicinalUses: Primarily valued as a nutritious culinary herb rather than a medicine.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
